agenda_items.section: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL
agenda_items.title: CALL TO ORDER AND ROLL CALL:
agenda_items.outcome_summary: Mayor Toor called the regular July 17, 2001 meeting of the Boulder City Council to order at 6:00 p.m. in the Council Chambers.

agenda_items.title: CITIZEN PARTICIPATION and COUNCIL/STAFF RESPONSE:
CONSENT AGENDA:
APPROVAL OF THE CITY COUNCIL MEETING MINUTES FROM JULY 3, 2001.

CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION CONCERNING THE PROPOSED CITY OF BOULDER, COLORADO PARKS, RECREATION AND MUNICIPAL CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT REFUNDING BONDS, SERIES 2001, IN A PRINCIPAL AMOUNT NOT TO EXCEED $5,500,000; AUTHORIZING THE OFFICIAL NOTICE OF BOND SALE WITH RESPECT TO SAID SERIES 2001 BONDS; PRESCRIBING CERTAIN DETAILS CONCERNING SAID PROPOSED SALE AND SAID SERIES 2001 BONDS; APPROVING THE FORM OF A PRELIMINARY OFFICIAL STATEMENT; AND PROVIDING THE EFFECTIVE DATE OF THIS RESOLUTION.

THIRD READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE No. 7133 AMENDING SECTION 4-5-5 AND CHAPTER 6-1, B.R.C. 1981, REGULATING KEEPING OF WILD AND EXOTIC ANIMALS, DISTURBING PRAIRIE DOG BURROWS, AND CONCERNING SERVICE ANIMALS ON THE MALL.
THIRD READING AND CONSIDERATION OF:
ORDINANCE No. 7145 AMENDING CHAPTER 6-3, B.R.C. 1981, CONCERNING TRASH AND RECYCLABLE MATERIALS; AND
ORDINANCE No. 7146 AMENDING SECTION 5-4-14, B.R.C. 1981, CONCERNING GRAFFITI.
CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION TO APPROVE A QUIT CLAIM OF THE CURRENT WATER LINE EASEMENT LOCATED ON PARCEL A TO BRANDING IRON OR SFP REALTY PRIOR TO JULY 30, 2001.
MATTERS FROM THE CITY MANAGER: - none
MATTERS FROM THE CITY ATTORNEY: - none

agenda_items.title: PUBLIC COMMENT: - none
FINAL DECISIONS:
ITEMS RELATING TO THE BOULDER VALLEY COMPREHENSIVE PLAN (BVCP):
CONSIDERATION OF ADDITIONAL PROPOSED CHANGES TO THE BOULDER VALLEY COMPREHENSIVE PLAN (BVCP) POLICIES INCLUDING THE JOBS: POPULATION BALANCE, AS PART OF THE FIVE-YEAR UPDATE.

CONSIDERATION OF GENERAL PROPOSED TEXT CHANGES TO THE BOULDER VALLEY COMPREHENSIVE PLAN (BVCP) AS PART OF THE FIVE-YEAR UPDATE. CHANGES ARE PROPOSED FOR THE FOLLOWING SECTIONS: INTRODUCTION, POLICY SECTION INTRODUCTIONS, SUB-COMMUNITY AND AREA PLANS, MASTER PLAN AND PROGRAM SUMMARIES, TRAILS MAPS, REFERRAL PROCESS, ANNEXATION PROCESS, IMPLEMENTATION SECTION INTRODUCTION, URBAN SERVICE CRITERIA AND STANDARDS, AND POPULATION AND EMPLOYMENT PROJECTIONS.

SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE No. 7144 AMENDING THE DEVELOPMENT EXCISE TAX (DET) TO ESTABLISH CRITERIA FOR GRANTING A WAIVER OF THE DET ON CERTAIN PERMANENTLY AFFORDABLE HOUSING UNITS.
CONSIDERATION OF A MOTION APPROVING A PROPOSED NEXT-STEPS AND ACTIVITIES PROGRAM FOR SOUTH BOULDER CREEK FLOODPLAIN MANAGEMENT AND MITIGATION STUDY.

ITEMS PERTAINING TO TITLE 9, LAND USE REGULATIONS, AND TITLE 10, STRUCTURES, OF BOULDER REVISED CODE 1981, TO ALLOW THE RELOCATION OF RESIDENTIAL STRUCTURES FROM THE GRANDVIEW TERRACE AREA OF THE UNIVERSITY OF COLORADO TO TWO SITES WITHIN THE CITY OF BOULDER:

SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE No. 7147 CONCERNING THE RELOCATION OF TWO SINGLE-FAMILY STRUCTURES FROM 1513 13 TH STREET AND 1225 GRANDVIEW TO CHAUTAUQUA PARK (TO BE LOCATED AT TWO OF THE FOLLOWING THREE SITES: 808-B BOGGESS CIRCLE, 811 BOGGESS CIRCLE, OR 504 ASTOR LANE). VARIATIONS TO THE LAND USE REGULATIONS INCLUDE A REDUCTION OF SETBACKS, A REDUCTION OF PARKING SPACES AND FEE WAIVER.

SECOND READING AND CONSIDERATION OF ORDINANCE No. 7148 CONCERNING THE RELOCATION OF A DUPLEX FROM 1434 15 TH STREET TO 905 MARINE STREET. VARIATIONS TO THE LAND USE REGULATIONS INCLUDE AN INCREASE IN RESIDENTIAL DENSITY ABOVE THE ALLOWED DENSITY, REDUCTION OF SETBACKS, REDUCTION OF PARKING SPACES, WAIVER OF BUILDING CODE REQUIREMENTS AND FEE WAIVER.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Corson, to approve Consent Agenda Items 3A, 3B and 3E.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5:0. Councilmembers Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Corson, to reschedule the September 18 th meeting to September 25 th in order to honor Rosh Hashanah which fall on September 18th.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5:0. Councilmembers Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Poinsatte, to adopt the proposed changes to the Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan (BVCP) including the modified changes submitted by the County Commissioners regarding the Jobs: Population Balance, as part of the five-year update.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 3:2. Havlick and Riggle opposed. Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Riggle moved, seconded by Poinsatte, to modify language to add “Given current policies” to beginning of second sentence and second paragraph in County Commissioner’s recommended changes.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5-0. Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Riggle moved, seconded by Poinsatte to amend to combine the last two sentences of paragraph two, striking the words, “a project to determine whether or not the 1:1 ratio is appropriate. This will be accomplished through.”
motions.vote_text: The motion failed: 2:3. Poinsatte and Toor opposed. Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Havlick to change the work “project” to “public process” in paragraph two.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5:0. Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Havlick, to approve all text changes to the Boulder Valley Comprehensive Plan (BVCP) as part of the five-year update.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5:0. Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Poinsatte, to adopt Ordinance No. 7144 amending the Development Excise Tax (DET) to establish criteria for granting a waiver of the DET on certain permanently affordable housing units.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5:0. Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Corson moved, seconded by Riggle, to adopt a proposed next-steps and activities program for South Boulder Creek Floodplain Management and Mitigation Study planning.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5:0 . Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Poinsatte to adopt Ordinance No. 7147 concerning the relocation of two single-family structures from 1513 13 th Street and 1225 Grandview to Chautauqua Park (to be located at two of the following three sites: 808-B Boggess Circle, 811 Boggess Circle, or 504 Astor Lane).
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5:0. Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Friendly amendment made to relocation of two single-family structures from 1513 13 th Street and 1225 Grandview to Chautauqua Park.
Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Havlick, to adopt Ordinance No. 7148 concerning the relocation of a duplex from 1434 15 th Street to 905 Marine Street.
motions.vote_text: Vote was taken on a motion to adopt as amended. The friendly amendment was accepted: 5:0.

motions.motion_text: Friendly amendment made to defer fee for planning review until one-year after certificate of occupancy.
Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Poinsatte, to adopt Ordinance No. 7133 as amended by the City Attorney by emergency ordinance.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5:0. Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Councilmember Havlick moved, seconded by Poinsatte, to adopt Ordinance No. 7145 concerning trash and recyclable materials as amended.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5:0. Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: Mayor Toor moved, seconded by Corson, to adopt Ordinance No. 7146 concerning graffiti.
motions.vote_text: The motion carried: 5:0. Eldridge, Lopez, Mock and Morzel absent.

motions.motion_text: There being no further business to come before Council at this time, BY MOTION REGULARLY ADOPTED, THE MEETING WAS ADJOURNED AT 10:20 P.M.

open_comment_speakers.name: Lynn Segal
open_comment_speakers.topic: voiced appreciation for the contributions by John Sherwood; and with regards to Crossroads, questioned the need for Urban Renewal Authorities and urged dis-banning of BURA.

open_comment_speakers.name: Rob Smoke
open_comment_speakers.topic: Also acknowledged the value of John Sherwood and his numerous contributions to the Boulder community, noting that he will be missed by many.
